description: Maya keeps the family's backyard beehive and must decide how and when to harvest its honey, how much to leave for the colony, and how her brother and cousin will safely take part.

shared_context.S1: The family backyard has one active beehive that produced about 18 standard jars of honey this season.
shared_context.S2: Maya is responsible for the hive and will make the final plan for harvesting and sharing the honey.
shared_context.S3: Jordan and Rosa both want to help with the harvest and receive some of the honey.
shared_context.S4: Before opening the hive, Maya's usual family routine is to go around the group and ask each person what they need to know and what they can take on.
shared_context.S5: The hive is beside the back fence, and the family has protective veils and sealed jars available.

PF1.text: Jordan has a serious bee-sting allergy and must not come within 10 meters of the hive; he can still receive a sealed jar away from the yard.

PF2.text: Rosa spoke with the family's neighbor, who keeps bees professionally, and was told that this hive should be harvested at exactly 18:00 on September 20, 2027, with 12 jars taken and 6 jars left for the colony; she has not shared that advice with Maya.

acceptance_conditions: The harvest must take place on September 20, 2027.
The harvest must begin at exactly 18:00.
Exactly 6 jars must be left for the colony.
Jordan must be kept at least 10 meters from the hive and receive any honey through a sealed handoff away from the yard.
A commitment must record the harvest plan.
A commitment must record Jordan's allergy safety arrangement.
Rosa's neighbor-beekeeper advice must be cited as justification.

decisive_facts.why: Jordan's allergy changes his participation from ordinary hands-on harvesting to staying at least 10 meters away and receiving a sealed jar away from the yard, which also requires the allergy-safety commitment.

The neighbor-beekeeper's advice changes the harvest date to September 20, 2027, the start time to 18:00, the amount taken to 12 jars, and the amount left to 6 jars, while supplying the specific harvest commitment and cited justification.
